domHealth.title: DOM Health
domHealth.intro: Assess how reliably Apty-style element selection could target this page or application: real selector generation, live uniqueness/stability verification, and hit testing — not a generic DOM statistic. Nothing runs until you click "Check DOM Health" or "Audit Application".
domHealth.loadingPage: Taking three DOM snapshots over a few seconds and verifying selectors live against the page — this takes a few seconds.
domHealth.loadingApp: Discovering same-origin pages from real links already on the page (never by clicking anything), then auditing each one in turn — this can take up to a few minutes and will navigate this tab through several pages.
domHealth.unableToAuditApp: Unable to run the application audit.
domHealth.observedPageNote: Observed current-page DOM health: {{score}} — never application-wide health from a single page. For the whole application, use "Audit Application".
domHealth.coverageNote: Coverage is observed, not total — this audit cannot know how many states the application actually has. Discovery: {{method}}.
domHealth.crossStateTitleOne: Cross-State Selector Replay ({{count}} other state tested)
domHealth.crossStateTitleMany: Cross-State Selector Replay ({{count}} other states tested)
domHealth.crossStateIntro: Of {{attempted}} element path(s) captured at the seed state and replayed against other discovered states: {{resolved}} still resolved correctly,

aiProvider.label: AI provider
aiProvider.notConfigured: No API key or model is set.
aiProvider.notConfiguredFix: Open Settings → AI Configuration, enter the API key and a model for your provider, turn it on and click Save Settings.
aiProvider.callsTools: {{model}} answered in {{latency}} ms and calls tools.
aiProvider.noTools: {{model}} answered in {{latency}} ms but did not call a tool. The agent needs function calling.
aiProvider.noToolsFix: Choose a model that supports function (tool) calling: in AI Configuration, Test Connection marks each model.
aiProvider.toolsUnknown: {{model}} answered in {{latency}} ms; whether it calls tools could not be determined.
aiProvider.toolsUnknownFix: Run Test Connection in AI Configuration again; if it stays unknown, try a model the provider documents as supporting tools.
aiProvider.noAnswerFix: Check the API key, AI Host and model in AI Configuration, then click Test Connection to see the provider's answer.

aptyClient.label: Apty Client
aptyClient.notConnectedFix: Open Settings → Apty Integration, click Detect (or paste the Client's extension ID) and click Connect.
aptyClient.notInstalled: No enabled extension has the ID {{id}}.
aptyClient.notInstalledFix: Install or enable the Apty Client in chrome://extensions, or correct the ID in Apty Integration.
aptyClient.noAnswer: The Apty Client did not answer.
aptyClient.fixNoReceiver: The Apty Client does not let this extension in. Add "{{agentId}}" to externally_connectable.ids in the Client's manifest.json, reload the Client in chrome://extensions, then run the checks again.
aptyClient.fixNoResponse: The Apty Client answers but has no Agent bridge. Install the Agent bridge module in the Client's service worker (docs/integrations/apty/README.md) and reload the Client.
aptyClient.fixTimeout: The Apty Client accepted the message but never answered. Install or update the Agent bridge module in its service worker, and check chrome://extensions for errors on the Client.
aptyClient.fixSendFailed: Chrome refused to message the Apty Client. Check that the extension ID in Apty Integration is the Client's ID (32 letters a–p).
aptyClient.fixMalformed: The Apty Client's bridge module is out of date. Update it to the current contract (docs/integrations/apty/README.md).
aptyClient.noResources: The Client answers the handshake but not the request list.
aptyClient.noResourcesFix: Update the Agent bridge module in the Client: it must answer apty-debug-agent:list-observed-resources.
aptyClient.answering: Answering: status, logs and {{count}} observed request(s).

boundTab.label: Page and frames
boundTab.noPageFix: Open the application in a tab (an http or https page), click into it once, then run the checks again.
boundTab.framesUnlisted: The frames of {{host}} could not be listed.
boundTab.reloadFix: Reload the tab, then run the checks again.
boundTab.someAnswerFix: Reload the tab so every frame gets the page script. A frame that still does not answer is blocked by the page (sandboxed or a browser page).

consoleBridge.label: Console and routing capture
consoleBridge.off: Turned off: console output is read only from when you ask, and DOM Health cannot measure routing.
consoleBridge.offFix: Settings → General → Troubleshooting: turn on "Track client-side routing and capture console output from page load".
consoleBridge.notRegistered: The page script is on in Settings but not registered.
consoleBridge.excluded: {{host}} is in "Sites where that script never runs".
consoleBridge.excludedFix: Remove {{host}} from that list in Settings → General → Troubleshooting if this site should be captured.
consoleBridge.someFrames: Running in {{count}} of {{total}} frame(s); missing in {{missing}}.
consoleBridge.someFramesFix: Reload the tab: frames loaded before the script was registered do not have it.

clipboard.label: Copy to clipboard
clipboard.granted: Copy buttons can write to the clipboard.
clipboard.denied: Writing to the clipboard is blocked.
clipboard.prompt: Chrome will ask before the first copy.
clipboard.fix: Allow clipboard access for this extension: chrome://settings/content/clipboard.

storage.label: Storage access
storage.blocked: Only the extension's own pages can read its storage (API keys stay out of pages).
storage.readable: A script in a web page can read the extension's storage, including API keys.
storage.unknown: Could not check without an open web page.
storage.readableFix: Reload the extension in chrome://extensions so its service worker restricts storage again.
storage.unknownFix: Open a web page and run the checks again.
